ZEUSANCIENT-AIR_QUALITY.title: Air Quality
ZEUSANCIENT-AIR_QUALITY.description: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
ZEUSANCIENT-AIR_QUALITY.flavor: "That tingling sensation in the air, that's a sure sign that victory's at hand!"
ZEUSANCIENT-DIVINE_VENGEANCE.title: Divine Vengeance
ZEUSANCIENT-DIVINE_VENGEANCE.description: Whenever you are attacked, deal [blue]{Damage::diff()}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
ZEUSANCIENT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.title: Double Strike
ZEUSANCIENT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.description: Upon pickup, enchant ALL cards containing "Strike" in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Double[/purple].
ZEUSANCIENT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.flavor: "Become as lightning, Niece, and strike our enemies before they know what hit them!"
ZEUSANCIENT-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.title: Electric Overload
ZEUSANCIENT-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.descriptio: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, take [blue]{Damage:diff()}[/blue] damage for each unspent Energy.
ZEUSANCIENT-ELECTRIC_OVERLOAD.flavor: "There is no limit to the wrath of Olympus. Best not invite it on yourself again."
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.title: Heaven Flourish
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.description: The first [blue]2[/blue] Skills you play each combat are played an extra time.
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_FLOURISH.flavor: "You witches have a natural spark in you, I know, but here! I've got another."
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_STRIKE.title: Heaven Strike
ZEUSANCIENT-HEAVEN_STRIKE.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage, apply [gold]Blitz[/gold].
ZEUSANCIENT-IONIC_GAIN.title: Ionic Gain
ZEUSANCIENT-IONIC_GAIN.description: Every [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Aether Font[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ZEUSANCIENT-POWER_SURGE.title: Power Surge
ZEUSANCIENT-POWER_SURGE.description: Whenever you end your turn with any unspent Energy, deal damage equal to [blue]{Damage::diff()}[/blue] times the current turn number to ALL enemies.
ZEUSANCIENT-POWER_SURGE.flavor: "Do show our enemies a properly electrifying time for me, would you?"
ZEUSANCIENT-SHOCKING_LOSS.title: Shocking Loss
ZEUSANCIENT-SHOCKING_LOSS.description: Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, you may remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ZEUSANCIENT-STATIC_SHOCK.title: Static Shock
ZEUSANCIENT-STATIC_SHOCK.description: Whenever you deal unblocked attack damage to an enemy, deal [blue]{PercentDamage}%[/blue] of that damage to a different random enemy. If there are no other enemies, deal it to the original target instead.
ZEUSANCIENT-STATIC_SHOCK.flavor: "Our enemies will soon be in for quite the shock, I think!"
ZEUSANCIENT-STORM_RING.title: Storm Ring
ZEUSANCIENT-STORM_RING.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Each turn, if there is more than one enemy, a random enemy is marked for that turn. Your first [blue]{ForcedTargetingCardCount}[/blue] cards that target an enemy must be played on the marked enemy.
ZEUSANCIENT-THUNDER_RUSH.title: Thunder Rush
ZEUSANCIENT-THUNDER_RUSH.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] Orb Slots. Upon pickup, enchant ALL your basic Defend cards with [purple]Thundercall[/purple].
